summary: setup options: fact_path for local .fact files (executable files run, JSON or INI output, PowerShell on Windows) feeding ansible_local, and filter for fnmatch-matching fact names.
questions: How do I add custom local facts to a host?
How do I gather only network-related facts?
How do custom facts work on Windows?

answer_card.title: setup fact_path and filter
answer_card.answer_md:
- `fact_path` (`/etc/ansible/facts.d`): `*.fact` files; executables are run, others read; JSON or INI. Results go into `ansible_local`. On Windows, files must be `.ps1` returning an object, and results use a variable named after the file.
- `filter`: list of fnmatch patterns, e.g. `['ansible_eth*', 'ansible_default_ipv4']`
